measured.platform_note: offscreen（QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen）；真实合成器/vsync 还会加渲染开销，故这些是自动化能拿到的下界，不是最终发布门禁数字。【2026-07-20 修正】此前 idle_rss 47.9 / cold 0.37 / warm 0.36 量的是 main_window.build_application([]) 的空壳——没有页面、没有表格、没有图。数字本身没造假，量错了对象：预算文档声称描述「应用」，而用户等待与占用的是装好五页的窗口。改为测量 qt_app.app.build_app 装配后的真主窗，RSS 由 47.9 升到 67.6 MiB（预算 250），冷启动 0.37→0.64 s（预算 4.0），热启动 p95 0.36→0.56 s（预算 2.5）。三项仍有数倍余量，但记录的值此前系统性偏低 40–75%。

budgets.method: QElapsedTimer wraps each Qt slot/event-handler invocation during the benchmark run; p95/p99 computed over all captured samples
budgets.scenario: 20-run benchmark exercising typical UI interactions (click, keypress, tab switch) per sample_policy

budgets.method: QElapsedTimer measures wall-clock time from the user-triggered action to the busy/loading indicator becoming visible
budgets.scenario: triggering an individual-stock or screener analysis run while idle

budgets.method: QElapsedTimer measures wall-clock time from the cancel/stop request to the UI showing the stopping state
budgets.scenario: cancelling an in-flight individual-stock or screener analysis run

budgets.method: QElapsedTimer measures wall-clock time for a sort or filter operation to complete and repaint
budgets.scenario: 5000-row result table, single-column sort then a filter change

budgets.method: frame timestamps captured during a scripted scroll are converted to instantaneous fps
budgets.scenario: continuous scroll through the 5000-row result table

budgets.method: wall-clock time from process launch to the main window's first paint event
budgets.scenario: cold application launch, 20 repeated runs per sample_policy with no prior warm process

budgets.method: wall-clock time from process launch to the main window's first paint event
budgets.scenario: relaunch immediately after a prior run in the same session (OS file cache warm)

budgets.method: process RSS read via the OS process-info API after the main window is shown and idle
budgets.scenario: application idle at the main window with no analysis in flight, sampled once startup settles

budgets.method: process CPU percent sampled at 1s intervals over a fixed idle window and averaged
budgets.scenario: application idle at the main window with any monitor/alert timers running, no user interaction

budgets.rebaseline_rule: after first approved clean Qt build, regression <=10%
budgets.method: file size of the built onefile executable measured on disk after a clean PyInstaller build
budgets.scenario: clean release build per scripts/build_exe.py (see G-BUILD)

budgets.method: process RSS sampled before opening and after closing a dialog, repeated 100 times; growth = final RSS minus initial RSS
budgets.scenario: open/close a modal dialog (e.g. help) 100 times in a row with no other user action
